facts.text: Newly enrolled full-time undergraduate students making positive academic progress can receive the Bridge Forward Grant.

sources.title: Grants Info - South University
sources.quote: The Bridge Forward Grant is for eligible newly enrolled students at South University to reward undergraduate students for positive academic progress and continuous full-time enrollment. Students must begin classes on or after September 15th, 2026.
